summary: Findings-only rendering audit delivered: docs/audit/v19/rendering.findings.json (31 findings, schema-pinned 12 keys, valid enums: 15 wrong / 13 ok / 3 suspect; 8 major / 23 minor) + docs/audit/v19/rendering.md (verdict+severity+per-area summary tables, headline measurements, top-3 fix list, reproduction commands). No product file was touched (git status: only the two new audit files under docs/audit/v19/). Every number was produced in this checkout at HEAD 54d75a1 by executing the SHIPPED modules through the repo's own node:module TS/TSX loader (probes + raw logs under .dsh-scratch/audit-rendering/, gitignored): materials factories read field by field (7 presets), all 138 manifest parts traced to the material instance each renders with, 304 records' origin3d/size3d vs manifest bboxes, the 53 courses' waypoint ranges, the v17 mirror mechanism, and the live-section hit test reproduced from the shipped rule over 241 sliced parts (138 GLBs parsed with three's GLTFLoader + 103 procedural course parts) across 21 planes. Headline measured findings: (1) the known live-section hit-test precedence defect is STILL present - 386 of 2,522 contested points (15.3%) select a larger container than the structure under the cursor (vermis<-cerebellum, hypothalamus<-thalamus, LGN<-optic tract, raphe<-oculomotor; worst area ratio x24.7); (2) 8 of 23 tracts have chains that already cross x=0 yet are registered paired and mirrored, so the 'crossings stay single' guard is inert (0 midline tracts); (3) the 79 vessel course contours are built, sliced and gated but SectionCanvas appends only registryNerveParts(), so the 2D canvas/PiP never paint them (worker gets 162 of the 191 visible parts); (4) vessel tubes lerp to opacity 1.0 while committed arteries stay at 0.5 (the v18 E6 never applied); (5) the caudate nucleus (6,364 tris) and choroid plexus (3,032 tris) are drawn by NO 3D pass while LINKS says render:'body', and putamen/corpus-callosum are drawn twice because render:'none' is read by no renderer; (6) all transverse SVG plates draw anterior-down while the live canvas draws anterior-up (PLANE_BADGES.y = A-up), 6 plates use a contradictory four-corner badge compass, and plate-tel-sagittal-hemisphere's A/P badges are inverted relative to its own artwork. Verified clean with numbers: v18 vessel variant (solid crimson, no vertex-colour gradient, no striation - 14/14 fields identical to makeAnatomyMaterial('vasculature')), 0 records/bboxes outside CLIP_BOUNDS, 138 ellipsoid bodies with plausible 1.2 mm-scale sizes, 50/50 section #mirror twins carrying the authored group (twins select as the same record), SELECTION_STROKE #f59e0b width 3 + single-click select, PiP and Plates mounting the same SectionCanvas, v11 item-4 parity 6/6 incl. y=6/26/30/32, cortical-division sliver census 0 in every class with 3 dropped sub-threshold loops, and 360/360 plate label ids matching the SVG data-structure ids with all levelIds resolving. Verification run: node -e contract check (findings 31, exit 0), a 12-key/enum/empty-string schema validator (0 problems), and 8 rendering-related gates re-run green (vessel-render 75/75, area-toggles, cortical-lobes 564/564, pip-contract 187, nerve-kind 79, division-toggles 251, view-filter-consistency 102/102, cranial-nerve-render 47/47). Browser lanes (verify:acceptance/audit/browser) were not run and are not claimed - Chrome cannot start in this sandbox.
